meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Record a call, jot notes and let AI write them up with the transcript. No bot joins the call.

meetings.noAi: AI is off: you get the transcript, while AI notes and chat stay unavailable.
meetings.askPlaceholder: What did Ana say about pricing?

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.subtitle: Talk instead of typing in any zerosoft field: hold {shortcut}, speak and let go. AI adds punctuation, drops filler words and applies your corrections.
dictation.noAi: AI cleanup is off, so only basic cleanup runs (filler words, corrections, punctuation and your dictionary).
dictation.hint: Anywhere in zerosoft: hold {shortcut} to dictate into the focused field, double tap it for hands-free and press Esc to cancel. A short tap still types the key as usual. Ctrl+Cmd+V on Mac, or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V, pastes the last dictation.
dictation.rulesOnly: AI was not available: basic cleanup only.
dictation.rulesOff: Basic cleanup (AI cleanup is off in settings).
dictation.emptyBody: Hold {shortcut} in any text field. Every dictation lands here so you can copy it again.
dictation.deleteBody: It is removed from your history. Text you already pasted stays where it is.

settings.title: Voice settings
settings.subtitle: Your dictation shortcut, style, dictionary and meeting templates. They only apply to you.

dictation.generalDesc: How you start dictating and what language you speak.
dictation.shortcutHelp: Works on any zerosoft page. Double tap it for hands-free; a short tap types the key as usual.
dictation.showBar: Show a small dictate button when a text field is focused
dictation.aiCleanup: Clean up with AI (punctuation, filler words, corrections and lists)
dictation.stylesDesc: The same dictation reads differently in an email and in a chat. Voice picks the context from the app and the field.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.desc: Names and terms to spell right, words to replace and snippets you say to insert saved text.

phrase.word: How it is spelled, e.g. Turso
phrase.replace: What you say, e.g. zero soft
phrase.snippet: What you say, e.g. my booking link

help.word: Words help the transcription recognize names and jargon.
help.replace: Every time the transcription has the first text, Voice writes the second.
help.snippet: Say the phrase while dictating and Voice inserts the saved text.

templates.customDesc: Pick the sections AI uses for a kind of meeting. One heading per line, or instructions in your own words.
templates.name: Name
templates.instructionsHelp: Choose it in a meeting from the Template menu.
templates.empty: You have no templates of your own yet.
templates.builtinDesc: Sections each one asks AI to fill.
templates.deleteBody: “{name}” is deleted. Meetings that used it keep their notes.

desktop.title: Voice for Mac and Windows
desktop.desc: The desktop app dictates into any app on your computer and records meetings from the system audio (Zoom, Teams, Slack or any call).
desktop.unsigned: There are no signed installers yet: for now you build the app from the source code. Signed downloads come once the developer accounts for macOS and Windows are set up.
desktop.step1: Build it following the README in desktop/voice (Rust and Node needed).
desktop.step2: Create an API key with the voice:read and voice:write scopes in
desktop.step3: Open the app and paste the key and this server address:
desktop.step4: Hold Ctrl+Alt+Space in any app to dictate. Meetings recorded there show up in Meetings.
desktop.whatDesc: It uses the same API as this page, with your key.
desktop.what1: Global shortcut: dictates and pastes the text into the active app.
desktop.what2: Meetings with system audio: ScreenCaptureKit on macOS and WASAPI loopback on Windows, plus the microphone.
desktop.what3: Your dictionary and styles apply there too, because the cleanup runs on the server, and its dictations land in your history here.
